revision: 2 — triangle budget withdrawn; every mesh authored to what the form needs
units: world units, 1:1 — meshes are NOT scaled at draw time
handedness: left-handed, Y up, +Z forward; plane is Y=0; mesh origin = simulated entity position
shading: flat — vertices split per face, one normal per face, no welding, no smoothing groups

vertexColorConvention.R: team selector. 0 = hull palette. 255 = the owning player's TEAM colour. Values between are reserved and unused in the MVP.
vertexColorConvention.G: hull tone index, quantised: 0 = HULL.DEEP, 128 = HULL.BASE, 255 = HULL.EDGE.

layout: positions[] xyz, normals[] xyz, colors[] rgba 0-255, indices[] — all parallel, 3 vertices per triangle, indices are trivially sequential because vertices are face-split

Scout.name: Scout
Scout.note: small hull — blunt wide wedge, eight-point angular plan at 1.11:1. Five-section chined hull, two recessed drive nacelles, dorsal sensor blister. The Miner is a Scout with a mining laser in its one slot.

Frigate.name: Frigate
Frigate.note: medium hull — long pointed spine, thirteen-point plan at 2.14:1 with a hard outrigger step. Five-section chined hull, two closed outrigger blisters, aft drive block. The Fighter is a Frigate with two mass drivers.

ModuleFrame.name: ModuleFrame
ModuleFrame.note: empty base-module frame — octagonal beamed ring, four corner nodes, inner cross-bracing. One slot, no drive, never moves.

ModuleShipyardL1.name: ModuleShipyardL1
ModuleShipyardL1.note: shipyard L1 — open lattice spine: keel boom, two converging outer booms, four transverse frames, three N-truss bays, two gantry posts, command block with bridge and side pods aft. Members 3–5 units on 18-unit bays: the voids are the shape.

ModuleShipyardL2.name: ModuleShipyardL2
ModuleShipyardL2.note: shipyard L2 — the same lattice with a fourth bay and a third gantry post, plus a second stacked block and a mast on the command mass.

ModuleOreProcessorL1.name: ModuleOreProcessorL1
ModuleOreProcessorL1.note: ore processor L1 — one closed 16-sided drum, top hatch, three intake pods. Solid mass: the type cue against the shipyard truss.

ModuleOreProcessorL2.name: ModuleOreProcessorL2
ModuleOreProcessorL2.note: ore processor L2 — main drum plus a second stack joined by a transfer trunk, two intakes. Two masses: the count step.

Station.name: Station
Station.note: one per player, fixed, never moves. Chamfered plus-shaped plate, eight-sided hub tower, two point-defence mounts on the E/W arms, four arm-end docking nodes.
